title: GTA 6 Vehicle Sightings: Names, Evidence and Unknowns
subtitle: Separate editorial identifications from reviewed GTA VI appearance claims
excerpt: Our vehicle catalog distinguishes editorial names from source-reviewed fields. A trailer sighting does not establish top speed, price, availability or customization.
content:
## What Does a GTA VI Vehicle Sighting Establish?

A visible vehicle can support a narrowly scoped appearance observation. It does not, by itself, establish the official model name, performance, purchase price, spawn rules or customization options. Our earlier vehicle totals and speed claims did not meet that evidence standard and have been withdrawn.

Use the [vehicle catalog](/vehicles) to inspect each record's current status. The number of entries is our editorial inventory, not a confirmed count of vehicles in the final game.

## How to Read a Catalog Entry

| Record state | What you can conclude | What remains unknown |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Identification awaiting review | An editorial name has been assigned for organization | Whether the identification or GTA VI appearance is correct |
| Appearance evidence reviewed | Read the stated claim, source locator and review date | All fields the source does not establish |
| An unknown field | No approved value is published here | Do not replace it with a GTA V value or class average |

A broad Rockstar media link is useful for discovery, but a strong claim should also identify the supporting frame, passage or named section. Where a precise locator is missing, that limitation remains part of the record; do not treat a review label as independent proof of every attribute.

## Why We Do Not Publish a Fastest-Car Winner

A fair comparison requires verified measurements under stated conditions. We do not have source-approved GTA VI top-speed, acceleration or purchase-value measurements for these entries. Trailer editing, perspective and interface footage are not interchangeable with a repeatable performance test.

The [vehicle comparison workspace](/compare/vehicles) displays reviewed fields and unknowns side by side. An unknown value is not zero and does not earn a last-place ranking.

## Names, Images and Availability

Catalog images are editorial illustrations unless the record expressly identifies the depicted source. Similar bodywork does not establish an official model name. Appearance evidence also does not tell you whether a vehicle is purchasable, steal-only, included in an edition or available at launch.

See [Rockstar's official GTA VI site](https://www.rockstargames.com/VI) for current official media and purchase information. Check the exact notice or regional store listing before repeating edition-specific vehicle benefits.

## Where to Go Next

- [Browse vehicle identifications and reviewed fields](/vehicles).
- [Compare up to four entries without filling unknowns](/compare/vehicles).
- [Read the evidence and corrections policy](/editorial-policy).
- [Submit a source locator or correction](/corrections).

**Correction, 28 October 2026:** We withdrew unverified vehicle totals, the precise speed benchmark and unsupported availability/customization claims from this article and its summaries. Publication dates remain unchanged; the update date records this correction.
seo_title: GTA 6 Vehicles: Sightings, Sources and Unknown Stats
seo_description: Browse GTA VI vehicle evidence, separate provisional model names from reviewed claims, and understand which speed, price and availability details remain unknown.

title: GTA 6 Release Date, Platforms and Pre-Order Checks
subtitle: The official release date and platforms, with unverified logistics kept separate
excerpt: Rockstar currently lists November 19, 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Preload dates, regional unlock times, local prices and purchase terms need their own current primary sources.
content:
## When Is GTA VI Coming Out?

Rockstar's [official GTA VI page](https://www.rockstargames.com/VI) currently lists **November 19, 2026** for **PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S**. We checked that page on 28 October 2026. A scheduled date can change; use the publisher's page for the latest announcement.

The official platform list inspected here does not announce a PC release date. We do not convert earlier Rockstar PC-release intervals into a promised GTA VI schedule.

## What Is Verified and What Still Needs a Source?

| Question | Current answer in this guide | Evidence boundary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Release date | November 19, 2026 | Current Rockstar GTA VI page |
| Announced consoles | PlayStation 5; Xbox Series X\|S | Current Rockstar GTA VI page |
| PC release date | Unverified here | No dated PC announcement identified in this review |
| Preload opening | Unverified here | Requires an exact current platform or publisher notice |
| Regional unlock time | Unverified here | Requires a dated notice with region and time zone |
| Local price, refund and cancellation terms | Check your regional seller | Do not infer terms from another country or edition |

## How to Check an Edition Before Buying

Rockstar's current site advertises an Ultimate Edition and a Vintage Vice City pre-order offer. Follow the **Pre-Order Now** or edition-details control on the official page, choose your own platform and region, and read the current itemized listing.

Verify the included game, edition benefits, bonus cutoff, account requirements, tax and currency before paying. A promotional vehicle or item image does not establish every ownership, customization or gameplay rule associated with it.

We have withdrawn the previously listed fixed US prices, physical-format claims, retailer opening dates and bonus eligibility details because this guide did not attach the exact current primary notices needed to support them.

## Preload and Launch-Day Planning

Do not plan around the earlier November 12 preload claim, a rolling midnight unlock or a New Zealand time conversion from this article. Those precise statements have been withdrawn pending traceable platform-specific confirmation.

A calendar countdown on this site marks the release date; it is not a verified regional unlock timer. Check storage requirements, download availability and physical-delivery details with the relevant platform or seller when their notices are available.

## Should You Pre-Order?

That is a purchase decision, not a consequence of a countdown. Review the current cancellation/refund terms, delivery method and edition benefits for your region. You can also wait for more information. We do not describe preordering as risk-free or claim there is no downside.

## Sources and Corrections

- [Rockstar Games: GTA VI](https://www.rockstargames.com/VI) — release date, listed console platforms and current purchase-offer navigation; checked 28 October 2026.
- [Our editorial evidence policy](/editorial-policy).
- [Request a correction with a dated source](/corrections).

**Correction, 28 October 2026:** Exact preload/unlock times, unsupported price/format/bonus details, projected PC dates and absolute purchase assurances were removed. Original publication timing is retained; the update date reflects this review.
seo_title: GTA 6 Release Date & Platforms: Verified Purchase Information
seo_description: Rockstar lists November 19, 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Check current official offers and regional terms; preload and unlock details remain unverified here.

title: GTA 6 Trailer 2: Story, Characters and Evidence Limits
subtitle: The official trailer and character background, separated from gameplay hypotheses
excerpt: Trailer 2 was released on May 6, 2025. Rockstar's accompanying synopsis centers Jason and Lucia in a Leonida-wide conspiracy; cinematic scenes alone do not establish playable mechanics.
content:
## What Did GTA VI Trailer 2 Reveal?

[Rockstar's official Trailer 2 page](https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/trailer-2) dates the video **May 6, 2025**. Its accompanying synopsis presents Jason and Lucia becoming entangled in a criminal conspiracy across Leonida after a job goes wrong. It emphasizes their reliance on one another.

That story description is different from a specification of playable romance, character-switching, hacking or heist systems. The earlier version of this article blurred those boundaries; unsupported mechanical claims have been withdrawn.

## Jason and Lucia: Official Background

Rockstar's [Only in Leonida character page](https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/only-in-leonida), in the Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos sections, supplies their background.

Jason's profile describes a troubled upbringing, Army service and later work in the Keys. Lucia's describes her imprisonment, release and determination to change her circumstances. These are narrative biographies; they do not prove particular player abilities, mission objectives or relationship bonuses.

Read the separate [Jason profile](/characters/jason) and [Lucia profile](/characters/lucia) for the current source-linked records.

## How to Separate a Scene from a Mechanic

| Material | What it can establish | What it cannot establish alone |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Official synopsis | Publisher-stated story premise | Complete mission order or outcomes |
| Named character biography | Stated background and relationships | Playable skills, rewards or unlock rules |
| A cinematic action scene | What is visibly depicted in that scene | Whether the player can perform it or how a system works |
| Editorial interpretation | A clearly attributed hypothesis | A confirmed GTA VI feature |

A phone, firearm, vehicle or police presence in a scene needs a precise visual locator before being cataloged as an observation. A mechanic additionally needs a source that actually establishes its function. If that evidence is missing, say unknown instead of upgrading an interpretation into confirmation.

## Questions This Trailer Page Does Not Settle

This review does not establish that romance is optional, that ignoring messages changes a relationship meter, that a depicted phone implements a player-controlled hacking system, or that an action shot proves a new weapon's exact identity or statistics.

Likewise, a scene set in a business does not establish opening hours, passive income, a purchasable property or a mission reward. Our [map](/map) labels its provisional pins, and the [weapon catalog](/weapons) separates editorial identifications from reviewed fields.

## Continue with the Right Kind of Evidence

- Watch the [official Trailer 2](https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/trailer-2).
- Read Rockstar's [character sections](https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/only-in-leonida) alongside our [character directory](/characters).
- Inspect the [catalog comparison workspace](/compare/weapons) for field-level uncertainty.
- Read the [editorial policy](/editorial-policy) or [submit a correction](/corrections).

**Correction, 28 October 2026:** Repaired the malformed heading and replaced unsupported gameplay, music-list and view-count assertions with the narrower official story evidence. This article is the source-oriented story overview; separate observation notes should identify frames and label hypotheses.

seo_description: Read the official Trailer 2 synopsis and character background. Separate what Rockstar states from theories about romance, hacking, heists and gameplay systems.

title: GTA 6 Map Size: Evidence, Estimates and Comparison Limits
subtitle: Official geography, fan estimates and the limits of current map-size comparisons
excerpt: We have not verified an official area measurement or a traceable primary source for the map-size ratios previously published here. Here is how to assess GTA 6 map estimates.
content:
**Quick answer:** This article does not establish an official square-kilometer area for GTA VI or a verified multiplier against GTA V or Red Dead Redemption 2. The sources previously cited here did not provide a traceable basis for the ratios and quotations attributed to developers.

## What changed?

**Correction — October 27, 2026:** We withdrew unsupported developer attributions, numerical ratios, area estimates presented as established facts, and claims about fast travel and interior counts. Generic links to an outlet homepage or Rockstar's homepage do not substantiate a particular interview quotation. The earlier version is retained in our editorial remediation archive for accountability.

## What geography can readers check?

Rockstar's [Only in Leonida page](https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/only-in-leonida) identifies Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga. Those names establish destinations in the setting; they do not establish the area of a playable map.

Our [Leonida region guide](/news/gta-6-map-guide-leonida-regions-size) separates these destinations from questions about boundaries and travel systems.

## Why map-size estimates differ

A valid comparison needs the same measurement boundary in each game. A total including offshore water cannot be directly compared with a land-only area. Accessible interiors, underground spaces and a flat map footprint also describe different things.

A community reconstruction needs a stated scale, a reproducible method, dated source material and uncertainty. Matching a building to a real location may help an estimate, but does not prove the scale or arrangement of a fictional game world.

## What evidence would support a future comparison?

A developer quotation needs the exact interview, publication date and relevant passage or timestamp. A numerical measurement needs its units, boundary and method. A fan estimate needs attribution and must remain separate from an official measurement.

We will add a numerical comparison only after those details can be checked. Until then, this page provides no ranked area table and does not call a community projection a Rockstar-confirmed dimension.

## Explore the setting

See the [official GTA VI site](https://www.rockstargames.com/VI), our [region guide](/news/gta-6-map-guide-leonida-regions-size), and our [Port Gellhorn evidence guide](/news/gta-6-port-gellhorn-forgotten-coast-guide). The site's [fan map](/map) is an exploration aid, not an official map or surveying reference.
seo_title: GTA 6 Map Size: What Is Verified vs Estimated
seo_description: Understand the limits of GTA 6 map-size comparisons. Official geography, community estimates and measurement methods need separate evidence.
